description.zh: 表示发布流程阶段的代码，具体以GetPipelineRun接口的返回值为准
description.en: The code of the stage in the process. You can call the GetDeployment operation to query the code.

description.zh: 发布流程的唯一标识符
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。
description.en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID.

title.zh: 执行发布流程的指定阶段

descriptions.zh:
><notice>发布流程的阶段是有顺序的，详见GetPipelineRun返回值。不允许跳过或重复执行某一阶段。></notice>
><notice>执行过程是异步的，返回值只表示触发成功，不表示阶段执行成功。执行结果以GetPipelineRun返回值为准。></notice>
><notice>低版本的SDK中可能无该接口，此时请使用ExecDeploymentStage接口，参数与该文档一致。></notice>
descriptions.en:
> The stages in a process are sequential. For more information, see the GetDeployment operation. Skipping or repeating a stage is not allowed.

> The execution of a stage is asynchronous. The response of this operation indicates only whether a stage is triggered but does not indicate whether the execution of the stage is successful. You can call the GetDeployment operation to check whether the execution is successful.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public exec-pipeline-run-stage --project-id 10000 --id a7ef0634-20ec-4a7c-a214-54020f91XXXX --code DEV_CHECK --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
